draft.title: Unsaved edits
draft.text: Your edits have not been saved. Leave this form and discard them?
auth.footer: This console runs on your control server and makes no outside requests.
auth.setup_text: Choose a password for this console. You are its only owner: people, tokens, and settings live here, while servers stay on your computer.
auth.reset_text: This replaces the old password, turns off the sign-in code, and signs out every device.
auth.password_hint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong one.
auth.code_hint: Six digits from the app on your phone.
auth.forgot_text: Run this on the computer you deployed from. It prints a one-time link to choose a new password.
auth.unconfigured_text: This control service doesn't know its address yet, so sign-in stays closed. Update it from your computer:
auth.no_owner_title: This console has no owner yet
auth.no_owner_text: Run this on the computer you deployed from. It prints a one-time setup link, valid for 15 minutes.
auth.link_text: Setup links work once and expire after 15 minutes. Get a fresh one on the computer you deployed from:
reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.text: This change needs your password again.
totp.title: Sign-in code
totp.offer_why: A six-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone keeps this console safe even if the password leaks.
totp.offer_later: It's optional. You can turn it on or off later in Settings.
totp.step_app: Open an authenticator app (any app that supports TOTP).
totp.step_scan: Scan the QR code, or type the secret key.
totp.step_code: Enter the six-digit code the app shows.
totp.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.enabled_toast: Sign-in code is on. Other devices were signed out.
totp.on_text: Every sign-in asks for a code from your app.
totp.off_hint: Sign-in asks only for your password.
totp.off_text: Sign-in will ask only for your password. You can turn the code on again any time.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.no_domain: Passkeys need the console to open on a domain name; browsers never allow them on a bare IP address.
passkeys.not_built: This version of Meridian doesn't support passkeys yet. Use a password and, if you like, a sign-in code.
sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.text: A device stays signed in for 12 hours at most, and for 30 minutes without use.
nav.label: Sections
cli.title: Change servers with meridian on your computer
cli.text: This console never holds SSH keys, so a seized control server can't reach the others. Adding, moving, or removing servers happens where you deployed from.
people.lede: Everyone who connects through this fleet.
people.empty: No one here yet. Add the first person to share a link.
people.declared_hint: Your fleet file on the computer you deployed from lists this person.
people.name: Name
people.name_hint: Latin letters, digits, dots, dashes, and underscores.
people.name_invalid: Use 1–64 Latin letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores.
people.expiry_hint: Leave empty for no end date.
people.expiry_too_far: Choose a date before 2099, or leave this empty for no end date.
person.share_text: Send the link, or let them scan the code in their VPN app. It updates itself when servers change.
person.no_public_url: Links appear once your fleet is applied from your computer.
person.qr_alt: QR code of the subscription link
error.qr_export: Could not export this QR image. Reload the person and try again.
person.no_page: The public subscription address is not configured yet. Run meridian apply.
person.reset_text: The current period starts over from zero. If the limit stopped this person, they can connect again.
person.enabled_expired_toast: Enabled {name}, but access is still expired. Change the end date to reconnect.
person.enabled_limited_toast: Enabled {name}, but the traffic limit is still reached. Reset traffic or raise the limit to reconnect.
person.disabled_toast: Disabled {name}. Their link stops working within a minute.
person.status_disabled: Disabled by you. Their link answers with a notice until you enable them.
person.status_limited: Reached the traffic limit. Raise it or reset traffic to let them back in.
person.status_expired: The end date passed. Move it later to let them back in.
person.expiry_invalid: Choose a valid date and time, or {choice}.
error.expiry_too_far: The renewal reaches 2099. Choose an earlier date or remove the end date.
person.reissue_text: For a link that leaked. The old link and QR code stop working at once.
person.reissue_declared: Your fleet file lists this person, and their connection page moves with the link. Issue it on your computer:
person.reissue_confirm: The current link stops working at once. You'll need to send the new one. Registered devices are cleared too.
person.reissued_toast: Issued a new link for {name}. Send it to them.
person.remove_text: Deletes this person and their link.
person.remove_declared: Your fleet file lists this person, so the next apply would bring them back with a new link. Remove them on your computer:
person.remove_confirm: Their link stops working and their traffic history goes. This can't be undone.
servers.lede: Server health, reviewed allowances, and payment reminders.
revisions.lede: Every change applied from your computer, newest first.
revisions.empty: No revisions yet. They appear after the first apply.
revisions.same: Revisions {a} and {b} describe the same fleet.
tokens.lede: Keys for scripts and other devices to use this console's API. Each one can be revoked on its own.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.name_hint: Where it will be used, like "backup script".
tokens.revoke_text: Anything using this token loses access at once.
tokens.secret_once: Copy it now: it is shown only this once. Anyone with it can act with the scope you chose.
settings.title: Title
settings.title_hint: Shown in VPN apps and here. It comes from your fleet file, so change it from your computer: meridian setup, or delivery.profile_title in meridian fleet export, then meridian fleet import.
settings.public_url_hint: Links and pages start here. It follows your servers, so it changes only from your computer.
settings.password_text: Changing it signs out every other device.
settings.password_toast: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
error.network: Can't reach the control service. Check your connection.
error.copy: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {wait}.
error.rate_limited_link: Too many attempts with setup links. Wait a few minutes, then open the link again.
error.wrong_code: That code doesn't match. Check that your phone's clock is right.
error.link_invalid: This setup link expired or was already used.
error.owner_exists: This console already has an owner.
error.setup_required: This console has no owner yet.
error.csrf: The request was refused for safety. Reload the page.
error.ui_unconfigured: Sign-in isn't ready yet. Run meridian apply on your computer.
error.user_exists: Someone with that name already exists.
error.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again.
error.insufficient_scope: This needs more access than you have.
error.invalid_request: Some of the values aren't valid.
error.conflict: Something changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
error.declared_user: Your fleet file lists this person. Change them with meridian on your computer.
error.internal: The control service hit an error. Try again.
error.payload_too_large: That's too much to send at once. Shorten it and try again.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.devices_off: Off: devices are not tracked or limited. Meridian stores no device records.
privacy.devices_private: Each person's devices are counted by an unreadable fingerprint. Meridian stores no device names, systems, or apps. Someone who takes the control server can only check whether a device they already have was used.
privacy.devices_full: Meridian stores each device's ID, system, model, and app, and when it last fetched the subscription. Someone who takes the control server learns which devices each person uses. Addresses are never stored.
privacy.history_off: Off: Meridian keeps lifetime traffic totals and last seen, without daily history.
privacy.history_daily: Meridian keeps how much each person and each server used per day, for {days} days. Someone who takes the control server learns when each person was active.
privacy.restore_private: The fleet fingerprint key is kept out of snapshots. After a restore, private device records are cleared and devices register again at their next subscription fetch.
privacy.delete_devices: All device records will be deleted. Devices will no longer be tracked or limited.
privacy.rekey_devices: Stored device IDs will become keyed fingerprints. Their systems, models, and apps will be deleted.
privacy.reset_private: Existing devices keep their places. Meridian records each one's ID, system, model, and app at its next subscription fetch.
privacy.delete_history: All daily history for people and servers will be deleted. Lifetime totals and last seen are kept.
privacy.prune_history: Daily history older than the last {days} UTC days will be deleted.
privacy.rekeyed: Device records converted to fingerprints, their metadata removed: {count}.
privacy.no_changes_yet: No privacy changes recorded yet. Both levels default to off.
usage.window: Last {days} UTC days, including today. Retention: {retention} days. Only traffic received while history was on is included.
privacy.intro: Both features default to off. Your choices stay as set when you apply fleet changes. Every change is recorded below.
privacy.no_addresses: Client IP addresses are never stored, at any level.
privacy.device_limit_hint: Used when a person's own cap is unset. Default: 3 devices; range: 1–100.
privacy.history_days_hint: Default: 90 days; range: 7–730. Includes today. Shortening retention deletes older records immediately.
privacy.number_range: Use a whole-number device cap from 1 to 100 and retention from 7 to 730 days.
privacy.step_up: Saving requires a recent password confirmation, and a sign-in code if enabled.
usage.chart_alt: Bytes used per UTC day, oldest to newest
usage.empty: No recorded traffic in this period.
usage.off: Daily history is off. Lifetime traffic totals and last seen are kept.
error.history_off: Daily usage history is off. Enable it in Privacy settings to begin recording.
devices.title: Devices
devices.limit_hint: Leave empty for the fleet default. Caps take effect when device limits are on in Settings → Privacy.
devices.limit_invalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 100, or leave empty for the fleet default.
devices.off: Device limits are off. No device information is read or stored.
devices.private: Only the count is shown. Device names, systems, apps, and fetch times are never stored.
devices.clear_text: Frees every device slot. Devices can register again on their next subscription refresh. Existing configurations keep working.
devices.remove_text: Frees one device slot. This device can register again on its next subscription refresh. Existing configurations keep working.
people.limit_invalid: Enter a positive amount, or choose Unlimited.
people.limit_too_large: Use less than 8 PiB (8,388,608 GiB), or choose Unlimited.
error.timeout: The request timed out. Try again.
tokens.uncertain_text: A token may have been created, but no secret was received. Its secret cannot be recovered. Check the token list and revoke it before creating another.
i18n.unavailable: Language files could not be loaded. Retry from this server.
commands.title: Node command results
commands.cut_off_help: Recommended after a leaked link. This closes every open session on affected inbounds, including other people's. They reconnect for a moment. If the inbound API fails, Xray restarts and all its sessions on that node close.
commands.no_inbounds: There are no managed inbounds to reset.
commands.waiting: Waiting for access changes to apply
error.command_queue_full: This node has 64 unanswered commands. Wait for them to finish and retry.
commands.restart_text: Every open Xray session on this node ends. Everyone using it reconnects for a moment.
commands.no_core: This node has no running managed Xray unit. Apply its node configuration first.
settings.routing_ru_split: Russian destinations and private/LAN ranges go directly; other traffic uses the VPN. Detected BitTorrent peers also go directly in Xray JSON.
settings.routing_full: Internet traffic uses the VPN, including Russian destinations; private/LAN ranges and detected BitTorrent peers in Xray JSON go directly.
settings.routing_hint: Change this policy from your computer:
person.metadata_private: Only the owner and people/admin tokens can read these fields. They stay out of connection pages and subscriptions and ride encrypted backups.
person.note_hint: Plain text, up to 500 characters. Newlines are allowed; leave blank to clear.
person.note_invalid: Use plain text of at most 500 characters; newlines are allowed.
person.tag_hint: 1–16 uppercase letters A–Z, digits, or underscores. Leave blank to clear.
person.tag_invalid: Use 1–16 uppercase letters A–Z, digits, or underscores, or leave blank.
settings.contact_hint: Change this public contact on your computer:
server_allowance.title: Allowance and payments
server_allowance.short_month: Short months reset on their last day.
server_allowance.edit_hint: Change these settings through the reviewed CLI apply:
server_allowance.approximate: Approximate accepted user traffic (upload + download); excludes protocol overhead, the server's own downloads, and relay forwarding.
server_allowance.not_measured: Not measured: this server runs no traffic agent.
server_allowance.since: Counted since {date}; earlier use in this period is unknown.
notice.title: Notice for everyone
notice.delivery: Shown in apps and on connection pages. Saved with encrypted backups; events record the author, without the text.
notice.text_hint: One plain paragraph, up to 500 characters. Use {name}, {expires}, {days_left}, {used}, or {quota}.
notice.until_hint: Your local time, saved in UTC. Leave blank for no expiry.
notice.person_hint: Enter their account name, or leave blank for sample values.
notice.expired: The saved notice has expired and is no longer shown.
notice.paragraph: Use a single paragraph without line breaks or control characters.
notice.until_invalid: Choose a future expiry time, or leave it blank.
language.title: Subscription status language
language.hint: Apps use this language for disabled, expired, or limited accounts. A person can have their own preference; connection pages keep their language picker.
preview.invalid_user_agent: Use a User-Agent of up to 512 characters, without line breaks or control characters.
preview.invalid_accept: Use an Accept header of up to 256 characters, without line breaks or control characters.
preview.invalid_suffix: Choose info, json, v2ray-json, mihomo, clash, stash, or singbox for the suffix.
preview.title: Subscription format preview
preview.hint: See which format an app receives and why entries are omitted. Headers are used for this preview only; no connection keys or links are returned.
